title: DOW-UAP-PR080, "20 October 2020 [CALLSIGN] [CALLSIGN] Observes UAP"
what_is_it: Infrared video recording from a U.S. military sensor platform showing an unidentified anomalous phenomenon (UAP) in the CENTCOM area of responsibility.
interpretation_warnings: No extracted text from the video itself — all facts come from metadata and the CSV description provided by war.gov.
AARO uses the qualifier 'likely' when attributing the sensor platform, indicating uncertainty about the exact source.
The materials lack a substantiated chain of custody, meaning the provenance and handling history cannot be fully verified.
Callsigns in the title are redacted, preventing identification of the specific military unit or platform involved.
The video description appears truncated at the 02:45-02:46 timestamp entry, so later events in the video are not described.
The uploader-defined title does not confirm the video content matches the title's claim.
